description: ClickHouse upgrade rules matched against the observed workload (ADR 0016 §9). Each rule applies when the target version is at or above `since` and the workload matches. Maintained in this repository; extend it with each ClickHouse release.

rules.title: Columns use the legacy Object('json') type
rules.detail: The legacy Object('json') type is deprecated in favour of the JSON type. Plan a migration and test it on the canary before upgrading further.

rules.title: Databases use the deprecated Ordinary engine
rules.detail: Ordinary databases are deprecated; Atomic is the default engine. Convert them before relying on newer behaviour.

rules.title: Queries or profiles turn the new analyzer off
rules.detail: The new query analyzer is enabled by default since 24.3. Workloads that switch it off depend on the old analyzer; check their results on the canary.

rules.title: Settings profiles pin an older compatibility level
rules.detail: The `compatibility` setting keeps older defaults. Review which query shapes depend on it before removing the pin.

rules.title: Experimental database engines are in use
rules.detail: MaterializedPostgreSQL and MaterializedMySQL are experimental and may change between releases. Verify replication on the canary.

rules.title: Query shapes enable experimental settings
rules.detail: Experimental features can change behaviour between releases. Replay these query shapes on the canary.
